healHints.name: the product title, the large heading text near the top of the product (e.g. 'Aurora Wireless Headphones')
healHints.price: the price, shown as a dollar amount like '$129' next to the title
healHints.rating: the numeric rating shown near the price, a value like '4.6'
healHints.description: the paragraph of body text describing the product
healHints.image_url: the src of the main product image
